title: Evaluation of the Efficacy and Safety of Bempedoic Acid (ETC-1002) in Patients With Hyperlipidemia and Statin Intolerant

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to determine if bempedoic acid (ETC-1002) is effective and safe versus placebo in patients with elevated LDL cholesterol and who are statin-intolerant.

Posted outcomes: Percent Change From Baseline (PCFB) in Low-density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C) at Week 12. timeframe=Baseline; Week 12. Bempedoic Acid=-22.58 (±1.290); Placebo=-1.17 (±1.421). p=<0.001
